inputs.prompt: Did QuartzForms increase its export limit this month? Resolve the conflicting evidence where possible.

inputs.user_text: Did QuartzForms increase its export limit this month? Resolve the conflicting evidence where possible.

tool_calls.name: web_search
tool_calls.arguments: {"queries": ["QuartzForms export limit", "QuartzForms export limit increase November 2026", "QuartzForms pricing export limit changelog"], "intent": "change"}

outputs.content:
**Yes — for the Pro tier.** QuartzForms' official Pro release note says that effective November 6, 2026, exports increased from 200 to 500 per month [S2](https://quartz-change.example/pricing).

**Resolving the conflict:** the two figures aren't actually contradictory once you check dates. The 200/month figure comes from the Pro help article, which was last updated October 21 — before the change took effect [S1](https://quartz-help.example/pricing). So the help article is simply stale, not a competing policy. The release note is the newer, authoritative statement.

Two caveats:
- The evidence covers the **Pro tier only**; I found nothing on whether other tiers (Free, Team, Enterprise) changed.
- The help article hasn't been refreshed as of today (November 11), so users reading it will still see 200 — worth flagging to support if you're relying on it for documentation.

**Sources**
- [S2](https://quartz-change.example/pricing) — QuartzForms official Pro release note (published 2026-11-11)
- [S1](https://quartz-help.example/pricing) — QuartzForms Pro help article (last updated 2026-10-21)
